checks.name: V1 [L229's second condition is an artifact of the two-field treatment] the quantities L229 had to carry are listed against the single-field form, and those that survive counted, since a condition that disappears when a field is removed was never physics
checks.measured: of L229's extra structures, 4 of 4 are absent in the single-field form: {'a matter coupling lambda': 'absent -- matter couples to the potential itself', 'a coupling strength xi': 'absent -- there is no second field to couple', "a renormalisation of Newton's constant": 'absent -- mu -> 1 recovers Newton exactly', 'an equipartition condition': 'absent -- nothing to equipartition between'}
checks.reading: AQUAL modifies the Poisson equation for the potential itself. There is no second field, so no coupling, no renormalisation of Newton's constant and no equipartition. L229's equipartition condition is WITHDRAWN as physics; it was bookkeeping for a field that need not exist

checks.name: V2 [with the scale removed, the acceleration scale is an OUTPUT and kappa is its reciprocal slope] the deep-MOND equation is solved with the interpolating function written in dark-energy units, matched to the MOND form, and the result divided by the dark-energy acceleration
checks.reading: kappa = 1/c exactly, where c is the deep-MOND slope of the interpolating function measured in dark-energy units with the function normalised to one at high acceleration. No coupling, no Newton-constant shift, no equipartition. ONE number

checks.name: V3 [so kappa = 1/2 is a single statement about the shape] the slope required by the framework's value of kappa is solved for and compared with 1, the value every standard interpolating function has
checks.measured: kappa = 1/2 requires c = 2.0000; the standard shapes have c = 1
checks.reading: the function must rise TWICE as fast at the origin as every standard interpolating function does, while still saturating at one. That is the whole of kappa, stated as a property of a shape

checks.name: V4 [2 sqrt(8 pi/3) is kappa = 1/2 written in horizon language, not an independent candidate] the coefficient in a_0 = c^2/(N L_dS) implied by kappa = 1/2 is computed symbolically and compared with the expression asked about
checks.measured: kappa = 1/2 gives a_0 = c^2/(N L_dS) with N = 4*sqrt(6)*sqrt(pi)/3 = 5.788810; 2 sqrt(8 pi/3) = 5.788810; difference 0.00e+00
checks.reading: they are the same number to machine precision, and the symbolic form confirms it exactly. Your expression is not a rival to kappa = 1/2; it IS kappa = 1/2, written against the de Sitter horizon instead of the dark-energy density. Good instinct, and it carries no extra information

checks.name: V5 [every parameter-free shape gives slope one, hence kappa = 1] the initial slope of four standard interpolating functions is computed and compared with one, since a shape with no free parameter turns over at its own argument's unit value by construction
checks.reading: a function with no free parameter turns over where its argument is one, so in dark-energy units it puts a_0 at the dark-energy acceleration itself. That is kappa = 1, and it is what the natural shapes predict

checks.name: V6 [and the data exclude that] the kappa implied by the parameter-free shapes is scored against both independent measurements and the smaller discrepancy compared with three sigma
checks.measured: kappa = 1 sits 7.0 sigma from the BTFR measurement and 10.4 sigma from the distance-free one; the closer is 7.0 sigma
checks.reading: seven to ten sigma. The easy version of this principle -- take a standard shape, put its argument in dark-energy units -- is EXCLUDED by the programme's own measurements of kappa. That is a real result and it is negative

checks.name: V7 [the gap, now a single sharp demand on a shape] the requirement that survives is stated and its distance from the standard shapes measured
checks.measured: the shape must have initial slope 2.0 while saturating at 1, i.e. rise 2x faster at the origin than every standard interpolating function, with no free parameter to arrange it
checks.reading: that is not a small adjustment of the standard forms; it is a different shape. And it cannot be achieved by inserting a factor of two, because a factor of two IS a free parameter and the whole point of the principle is that there is none

checks.name: V8 [the honest verdict on the swing] the status of a derivation of kappa after this lane is stated against what was hoped
checks.measured: the principle now leaves ONE number, kappa = 1/c. The natural shapes give c = 1 and kappa = 1, excluded at 7 to 10 sigma. kappa = 1/2 demands c = 2 from a shape with no free parameter, and no such shape is exhibited here
checks.reading: so the swing connects: the principle is real, it removes the coupling and the equipartition that L229 had to carry, and it turns kappa into a single property of a curve. It does not produce one half, and the obvious way to try produces one instead, which the data rule out
